info.description: A stateful workspace assistant powered by Microsoft Foundry Agent Service, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and strict Human-in-the-Loop approval gates.
info.what1: Answers contextual questions about tasks and project notes in your workspace.
info.what2: Uses Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools for structured queries and task administration.
info.what3: Enforces human verification before creating tasks or committing permanent changes.
info.step1: Pick a starter suggestion or ask a question regarding your workspace tasks and documentation.
info.step2: The agent inspects notes and tasks through the connected MCP server in real-time.
info.step3: If a task creation is proposed, an approval card appears. The write only executes after your explicit approval.
info.canDo1: Filter and list open and completed tasks within the workspace.
info.canDo2: Search documentation and technical notes using keywords and semantic context.
info.canDo3: Prepare full task creation requests with title and description for human review.
info.canDo4: Stream real-time tokens and tool activity via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
info.cannotDo1: Never create or commit tasks without your explicit interactive approval.
info.cannotDo2: Never hallucinate or invent fake tasks or notes without evidence.
info.cannotDo3: Cannot access system files or arbitrary external APIs outside the MCP boundary.
info.cannotDo4: Cannot perform destructive or irreversible actions in your environment.
info.tool1Desc: Lists workspace tasks with an optional status filter (open/completed).
info.tool2Desc: Searches project notes by keyword matching and content relevance.
info.tool3Desc: Creates a task in the workspace — strictly gated by Human-in-the-Loop approval.
